section_name.description: Name of the main configuration section.

port.description: The primary TCP port the Gross service listens on.

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling concurrent requests.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Accepts DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

log_dir.description: Directory where service logs are written.

data_dir.description: Directory used for persistent runtime data (e.g., temporary files, state).

use_tls.description: If true, TLS encryption is enabled on the service port.

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS. Use ['*'] for all origins, or specify domains like ['https://example.com'].

hostname.description: Custom public hostname for this instance (e.g., for reverse proxy headers or self-referential URLs). Leave blank to use the system hostname.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a request before timing out.

max_upload_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in MB) for uploaded files.

extra_sections.description: Additional custom INI sections for third-party plugins or advanced tuning. Each section has a name and key-value options.

options.description: Key-value configuration pairs for the section (values are strings).
